other_conditions: Applicant must be a native of Chhattisgarh
Applicant must be either a senior citizen (aged 60 years or above) or a person with disabilities (aged 18 years or above)
Applicant must not have previously traveled under this scheme
Applicant must not be an income taxpayer
Applicant must be physically and mentally able to travel
Applicant must not suffer from any infectious or serious diseases such as tuberculosis, cardiac or respiratory disorders, coronary conditions, mental illness, leprosy, etc.
Travel will be organized only in government‑determined groups and only when the minimum number of passengers is met
Only the selected individual(s) may travel; no additional persons may accompany without separate approval
Pilgrims may not carry inflammable or intoxicating substances, jewellery, or any items that could affect the dignity of the pilgrimage
Spouse, life partner or assistants may be included as per specific provisions outlined in the application instructions
Group applications may contain up to 25 persons, with one person designated as the head of the group
benefits_summary: Provides a one‑time assisted pilgrimage outside the state for senior citizens (60+) and persons with disabilities from Chhattisgarh.
documents_required: Application form in the prescribed format
Life partner's application (if spouse is selected)
Assistant's application (if an assistant is required)
Nominee contact details including mobile number
